title: NetColoc pipeline parameters
description: Fetches PCNet2.0 from NDEx, builds the network-propagation matrices, and computes z-scores for the 4 distinct dogCD/human-trait gene sets used across NetColoc's cross-species and single-species analyses.

pcnet_uuid.description: NDEx interactome UUID (default: PCNet2.0, 19,267 nodes / 3,852,119 edges).

seed_genes_dir.description: Directory holding the gene-set seed files (data/05_network/): OCDgenes_v4.txt, CCDgenes_Oct25.txt, human_DEP_noMHC_seed_genes_header.txt, human_schiz_seed_genes_header.txt.

toga_file.description: TOGA human-dog 1:1 orthologue mapping (data/05_network/toga_cf4_human_genes.csv) — used by PLOT_NETCOLOC_SCATTER (Fig. 1f).
